text.en: When taking Arc Damage, this weapon becomes more powerful and resists incoming Arc Damage. Kills extend the time in this overcharged state.
When taking Arc Damage, this weapon becomes more powerful and resists incoming Arc Damage. Kills extend the time in this overcharged state.

Recieving <arc/>Arc Damage activates Arc Conductor for 6 seconds. Direct Weapon Kills extend the buff by 3 seconds, up to 6 seconds.

While Arc Conductor is active, gain <pve 50% /> <pvp [15%] /> <arc/>Arc Damage Resistance.

Arc Conductor can be activated and grants its benefits even while stowed.
